thread_text:
jamie: @channel heads-up — proposing a temporary pin of runtime 3.5.1 -> 3.5.0-oldhash for tonight's change window (22:00 UTC) because SDK 4.0.0 changed request serialization for longseq and we saw a small mis-parse on canary. attaching quick notes and rollback plan.

tanvi: ack. can you paste the canary logs? :eyes:

jamie: sure — snippet:
```
2026-03-22T20:12:34Z ERROR parser: unexpected token at seq_len>2048
model: llama3q-2.7.3-quant
runtime: 3.5.1
sdk: 4.0.0-canary
stack: kv-cache parse->serializer
```

alex: hmm. is this limited to quantized longseq models or broader?

maria: initial triage: only longseq cohort (models with >2048 prefix) hit the error. Dedicated customers using those models will be affected if we don’t pin. ops-east recommends pin.

jamie: proposed plan: soft-pin runtime 3.5.0-oldhash for model-group:longseq-llama3q for the change window. Monitor token error rate and latencies. If error rate >1% over 30m, perform rollback to previous routing. If stable after 2h, lift pin. Release notes stub: "Temporary runtime pin to protect against SDK 4.0.0 serialization change for long sequences." Assign alex to publish.

ops-lead: change window approved 22:00-23:00 UTC. oncall: @tanvi. keep 30m heartbeat. :white_check_mark:

jamie: deploybot commands I plan to run (will run at T-5min):
```
# add a scoped pin
deploybot pin add --id pb-9812 --runtime runtime:3.5.0-oldhash --scope "model-group:longseq-llama3q" --duration 2h --meta "reason:SDK-4.0.0-serializer-canary"
# verify
deploybot pin status --id pb-9812
```

deploybot: [automated] pinlist update queued by jamie. will execute at 2026-03-22T22:00:00Z.

deploybot: pinned runtime:3.5.0-oldhash to scope:model-group:longseq-llama3q (pb-9812) — duration 2h — action_id=pb-9812 :tada:

tanvi: I'll watch telemetry (parser-error-rate, p50/p95 latency). please remind me of the rollback steps.

jamie: rollback options:
- `deploybot pin remove --id pb-9812` (remove the pin)
- `deploybot rollback --target runtime:3.5.1 --from runtime:3.5.0-oldhash --scope model-group:longseq-llama3q --force`
Use the pb id if possible so we don't unpin unrelated cohorts.

srebot: alert rule created: metric=longseq-parser-error rate>0.5% over 5m -> page @oncall-eng-sre. escalation: 15m -> ops-lead.

alex: tagging release notes: `/relnotes add "runtime pin during SDK 4.0.0 rollout for longseq models" --assignee @alex --impact low-medium`

maria: will draft a short customer comms for Dedicated customers in eu-west (ops-runbook + degradation guidance).

jamie: thanks all. I'll run the pin in ~5m and post the pb-9812 confirmation here. after the window we decide whether to lift or extend. :thumbsup:

deploybot: executed action pb-9812 at 2026-03-22T22:00:07Z — pin active. check `deploybot pin status --id pb-9812` for details.

tanvi: seeing initial telemetry — parser errors trending down after pin. continuing 30m watches.

jamie: update: after 2h no regression; plan to lift pin at 00:00 UTC unless owners request extension. will update relnotes and close loop on ship checklist.

maria: customer comms sent to allocated contacts for Dedicated customers; included rollback details and expected timeline.

jamie: final: lifting pin now. `deploybot pin remove --id pb-9812` executed. action_id=pb-9812-removed. :rocket:

srebot: note logged: pb-9812 lifecycle: created->active->removed. no pager events triggered.

alex: I'll publish the release note entry and mark the rollout as monitored-complete. thanks team.
